transcript:
Customer: Hi, I’m having some trouble with my subscription. I think I've been charged incorrectly.

Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you please provide me with your account email and a brief description of the charge you're concerned about?

Customer: Sure, it’s janedoe@email.com. I was charged for the Pro plan, but I only signed up for the Basic plan last month.

Agent: Thank you, Jane. Let me pull up your account. It looks like there was indeed an error during the billing cycle. 

Customer: I thought so! I can't afford to pay for the Pro plan right now.

Agent: I understand completely. I’ll initiate a refund for the extra charge, and we can confirm that your account is set to the Basic plan.

Customer: That would be great! How long will the refund take?

Agent: Refunds typically take about 3–5 business days to process. You’ll receive a confirmation email once it’s been initiated.

Customer: Okay, thank you for that. I appreciate the quick response.

Agent: No problem at all! Also, since you're on the Basic plan, I wanted to mention that upgrading to the Pro plan comes with some great new features, like enhanced analytics.

Customer: I don’t think I’m ready to upgrade right now. I just want to sort this out first.

Agent: Absolutely! Your satisfaction is the priority. If you need those Pro features in the future, feel free to reach out, and I can assist with that.

Customer: For sure. Thanks for your help today.

Agent: You’re welcome, Jane! If you have any more questions, don’t hesitate to call back. Have a great day! 

Customer: You too! Goodbye. 

Agent: Goodbye!
